pccs_master.hue20_change_watch: Keep 20:V until current authority actually changes it; current JCRI material only describes PB as a future rename, and the current DIC PCCS reference also lists 20:V / 青紫.
pccs_master.next: Acquire source-confirmed Japanese readings if needed and current representative PCCS sRGB values; do not relax the monitor display-value gate.

first_party_evidence: Current 2026 Color Certification Association Grade 3 sample explicitly tests 同一トーン配色, 対照トーン配色, 同一色相配色, 中差色相配色, and 明度のグラデーション.
Current Association level/text pages keep PCCS systematic color-scheme work in Grade 3 and state that exam questions follow official-text content.
Current JCRI material confirms PCCS relation/scheme instruction but the public first-party web material does not expose all numeric or pair boundaries.

Current Japan Color Research catalog describes the first-party 色の基本 chart as a PCCS teaching chart for understanding hue- and tone-based 同一・類似・対照 relationships, but its public preview does not expose the actual pair-membership table.
accepted_reliable_secondary_evidence: 2024 Journal of Home Economics of Japan peer-reviewed paper supplies PCCS hue-difference regions through complementary difference.
2026 J-STAGE emotion research independently confirms hue difference 1 = 隣接 and 2-3 = 類似, and gives a PCCS contrast-tone definition plus a concrete b/dk example.

2019 工学教育 peer-reviewed Kanazawa Institute of Technology paper, explicitly grounded in color-certification teaching material, defines 類似トーン as adjacent tones and supplies a coordinate-based adjacency judgment.

2001 日本色彩学会誌 paper explicitly labels multiple PCCS experimental pairs as 対照トーン, including v/lt, dk/sf, dp/b, s/dk, and p/dk; because it is an experimental subset rather than a complete rule, it is corroboration only.
boundary_audit.resolved: Named hue classification is source-resolved and runtime-promoted: 0 同一, 1 隣接, 2-3 類似, 4-7 中差, 8-10 対照, 11-12 補色.
boundary_audit.still_blocked: A complete auditable Grade 3 contrast-tone pair-membership matrix is not yet fixed. Similar-tone adjacency is source-supported, but do not infer missing contrast pairs solely from tone-map appearance or experimental subsets.

hue_difference.coverage: numeric circular hue differences 1-12 exactly once

hue_classification.coverage: numeric circular hue differences 1-12 exactly once across all nonzero named classes
hue_classification.derivation: 0 same; 1 adjacent; 2-3 similar; 4-7 medium-difference; 8-10 contrast; 11-12 complementary

authority_audit.finding: Current official Grade 3 material tests 対照トーン配色. Current first-party Japan Color Research teaching-material catalog explicitly states that PCCS tone relations include 同一・類似・対照, but its public preview does not expose the actual pair table. Peer-reviewed evidence defines 類似トーン as tone-map adjacency and contrast tones conceptually; a 2001 日本色彩学会誌 experiment explicitly labels multiple individual PCCS contrast-tone pairs, but only as an experimental subset. A complete Grade 3 contrast pair matrix is still not established.
authority_audit.next_source_route: Obtain an explicit readable rule/table behind the first-party Japan Color Research 色の基本 / PCCS instructional materials, or a new level-2 source that enumerates all 12 chromatic tone memberships. Use the 2001 experimental table only for pair-level cross-checking, not extrapolation.

value_gradient.coverage: 12 text-only monotonic stepwise lightness-sequence questions; 6 increasing / 6 decreasing; correct-index A/B/C/D = 3/3/3/3
value_gradient.official_sample_alignment: Current Grade 3 official sample explicitly states that a value gradient changes lightness stepwise.
